prompt.guidelines: Create a realistic 5-second product photoshoot animation. Use a slow cinematic camera push-in with a very gentle left-to-right orbit and subtle studio light movement. Keep the product centered, preserve the exact product shape, packaging, labels, texture, shadows, and proportions. Make the motion premium and minimal, suitable for an ecommerce product ad.

options.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, warped product, changing labels, changing logo, extra objects, low quality, flicker, jitter, melting, morphing, deformed packaging

input_object.generated_prompt:
A slow cinematic camera push-in toward the centered product, maintaining exact shape, packaging, labels, texture, shadows, and proportions. Over five seconds the camera advances gently forward while executing a barely perceptible left-to-right orbit around the product, keeping it perfectly centered in frame. Studio lights shift subtly: a soft key light brightens and glides a hair's breadth across the surface, creating a slow, realistic specular sweep over fabric texture and printed ink without altering color or contrast. Small, natural cloth micro-movements (slight settling of fabric at the hem and sleeves) respond to minimal air displacement but do not change fit or silhouette. Shadows on the backdrop and table deepen and soften in direct correspondence with the light sweep, preserving true contact shadows under the product. Depth of field is shallow but stable, with the focal plane tracking the product so labels and print remain crisply legible as the camera moves. The background stays neutral and unobtrusive; foreground edges remain in-frame at all times. Motion is premium and minimal, with no abrupt shifts — natural and realistic motion throughout.
Sound: near-total silence, only a barely audible neutral room tone at very low volume. No dialogue or voices, no music, no sound effects. No captions or on-screen text.
